trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload on Android 14. Repro: Start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, and come back. Deadline: Fixed and verified by Wednesday of the current sprint to allow QA time before the August 20th release.

trello.name: Verify Android 14 crash fix in QA
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Confirm the fix for the Android 14 photo upload crash on Android 14 test devices. Include this verification in the regression run once Marcus lands the fix.

trello.name: Implement offline mode sync API backend
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Build the sync API endpoint where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Implement last-write-wins conflict resolution (do not implement merge UI). Deadline: The sync API must be in review before Elena's absence on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement offline mode client-side logic
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Implement local cache using Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity is restored. Update the ticket with acceptance criteria: Users must be able to open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and have everything reconcile upon returning online with no data loss.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Finish the test and release pipelines for GitHub Actions (build job proof of concept already exists). Maintain the nightly build schedule. Run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week to ensure stability before turning off Jenkins. Do not turn off Jenkins until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Implement per-user rate limiting for search endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Add rate limiting to the search endpoint to prevent degradation from misbehaving scripts. Limit: 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when the limit is exceeded. Implementation must include a metrics counter to track who is hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update GDPR consent screen
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Update the privacy policy screen to meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Consent must be opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing; do not use a single pre-checked box. Obtain new copy from legal. Deadline: Must be included in the August 20th release as it is a launch blocker.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation. Ensure these tests run in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
